m.s: Lower {eggs} into a pot of boiling water and cook for 7 minutes for jammy yolks. Cool in cold water, then peel and halve.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Tear {turkish} into bite-size chunks, toss with a little oil and salt, and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and crunchy.
Whisk {mayo} with grated {garlic}, finely grated {parm*0.5}, the juice of {lemon}, {worcestershire} and plenty of black pepper. Loosen with a splash of water until it pours.

Halve {chk_breast} horizontally so the pieces are an even thickness. Season and cook in a hot oiled frying pan for 4 to 5 minutes a side until golden and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
In the same pan, cook {bacon} until crisp, then snap the woody ends off {asparagus} and char it in the bacon fat for 2 to 3 minutes.
Toss {cos} leaves with most of the dressing. Top with the chicken, asparagus, bacon, croutons and eggs, then the rest of the dressing and parmesan.

l: Keep the dressing and croutons separate and dress just before eating. The chicken and asparagus are good cold. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF bread for the croutons, baked on a separate tray. Check the Worcestershire, as some contain malt vinegar.
